title: Is the Recession Beginning?!?!?!
speaker: Meet Kevin (Kevin Paffrath)

macro_themes.view: PPI doubled expectations (mostly fuel) yet 10y yields fall as investors flee AI-trade fear into risk-free 5%.
Huge debt/equity raises (SpaceX, Broadcom, Oracle $140B) drain liquidity and hit hardware/tech, but AI underwriters (Anthropic) show the trade is not over.
Retail sales control group missed; labor market OK for now but early warning signs.
Market selloff pressures Trump toward an Iran deal, which would rocket stocks and bonds.

calls.reason: Called 5.27 as the top; flight from AI trade into risk-free bonds pushes yields down despite hot inflation; Iran deal would rally bonds.
calls.quote: 5.27 was going to be the top in the 10-year Treasury yield

calls.reason: Long-term floor near 78.77 respected for years; 5% risk-free attractive; TLT up is part of their suckening playbook.
calls.quote: TLT, where it is, very attractive offer

calls.condition: Lost 725; if 715 is lost, QQQ goes to 700
calls.reason: Capital raises weigh on tech near term; still expects 800 by year end; prior dip buys at 700-715.
calls.quote: I still have a belief that we go to 800 by the end of the year

calls.reason: Apple does not raise capital, so it outperforms during tech 'suckening' periods.
calls.quote: tech stocks do poorly with the exception of Apple because Apple doesn't raise capital

calls.reason: Said AMD overbought near ~620 and to sell year-end calls; hardware falls in suckening but expects big rally back later.
calls.quote: now would be a good time to sell some calls on AMD. I think AMD is over bought

notes: Kevin's own monologue, not a guest interview; typed macro_interview as closest. AMD call was originally made earlier (~620); long-term bullish is inferred from 'expect a big rally back' in hardware. Date: PPI/retail sales/Philly Fed 'just came out' = Thursday 2026-10-15 (same day as StockedUp PPI).
